answer.text: The tool kit is strapped underneath the pillion seat.
The kit has Allen keys in 8 mm, 6 mm, 5 mm and 4 mm, a C-spanner, a double end spanner 10 x 13 and an extension tube, one of each.
The kit also has a fuse puller, a ring spanner 24 x 14 combination, a front spindle adapter (one each) and a double end spanner 12 x 16 (quantity 2).

watchout_review.reason: The warning is about securing the wheel spacers and speed sensor when the front axle is removed. It does not concern the tool kit's contents or location.
